mathematics.assertion_tested: On the specified finite integral carriers and deterministic quotient families, one averaging pass followed by corner-supported cubic Newton correction lifts complete labeled orthogonal equivariant families modulo p^(e+k) to such families modulo p^9, preserving every prescribed matrix modulo p^k. Two constructed output families with the same prescribed reductions are related by the explicit invertible equivariant conjugator U=sum_i F_i E_i. Separately test adverse exact examples and small exhaustive input families.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact Z and Q, p-integral fractions, and finite rings Z/(p^D). No floating point arithmetic.
mathematics.conventions: Column-vector actions; average sum_g rho(g) A rho(g)^(-1)/|G|; e=v_p(|G|); C=I-sum previous projectors; correct C A C by 3A^2-2A^3; last label is complement; U=sum_i F_i E_i.
inputs: Explicit faithful integral carriers for C2, Klein four, C4, and S3, in fixed mixed integral bases

bounds.small_exhaustive_input: All sixteen rank-two matrices over F2; accepted idempotents determine complete labeled pairs (E,I-E) for the trivial group.
bounds.independent_vector_enumeration: All sixteen vectors modulo4 for each accepted small pair.
bounds.edge_cases: Empty family on the zero module and singleton identity family.
bounds.adverse_examples: Individually idempotent lifts need not be orthogonal; sum-to-I alone is insufficient; k=0 does not guarantee invertibility of U; an equivariant complete family mod4 for C2 admits no exact lift preserving mod4, already obstructed in one coefficient mod8.

non_claims: Does not prove universal lifting, DVR completeness, or convergence of Newton correction.
High-rank constructed families do not exhaust all quotient families.
Modular traces alone do not prove module ranks.
Does not establish arithmetic packet identification, Weil-Deligne attachment, or Hodge-Tate data.
The independent vector checks and polynomial factorization share the elementary matrix arithmetic helpers.
